clauses.name: Hermeto, the Observer
clauses.printedParagraph: When Hermeto enters an opponent's Empathic Vessel, the owner of this card can search for up to two cards in their deck. They show them and add them to their hand, then shuffle their deck.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Only opponent Vessel entry triggers for the immutable owner. Owner may select zero/one/two, reveal only selected cards, add them to hand, then shuffle once. Empty/single-card Decks and atomic refusals are checked.

clauses.name: Recall
clauses.printedParagraph: If you lost the confrontation this turn, search your deck for a card. Reveal it and put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Only a current-turn loss permits declaration. Available search requires exactly one card, publicly revealed, then shuffle; replay cannot move or shuffle again.

clauses.name: Mejik, the Labyrinther
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Mejik is in the Interzone, you may Exhaust it and declare a card name: Search a target player's deck for a card with the same name. That player discards that card, then shuffles their deck.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Unexhausted Interzone source declares a name as activation cost before opponent priority. Resolution uses that locked name even after source departure, discards from either target's Deck and shuffles once even on a failed search.

clauses.name: Poopom, the Hydromancer
clauses.printedParagraph: When Poopom enters the field, declare a card name, then uncover the top card of your deck. If the name of the uncovered card is the same as the declared one, Poopom gets +4 power until the end of the turn, otherwise Discard that card.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Real field entry asks for a name. Match by printed name keeps the top card there and gives exactly +4 until turn end. Mismatch reveals/discards only that card without drawing; source departure still permits reveal/discard; invalid name is atomic.
